safety_handling.rule: Safety contributes only when an explicit row-level finality flag is true.

migration_note: Use all_pairs_david_refined_ranking.csv and, for scientific reporting, top10_david_refined_with_cutoff_ties.csv. top10_david_refined.csv remains a fixed-N compatibility file; top10_shortlist_david_refined_order.csv is deprecated.
important: DAVID后处理覆盖输入的全部106个药对及其涉及的19味单药基线。安全或配伍证据未正式复核时，排名仅按靶点互补与DAVID通路两项计算，不能称为最终Top10。
limitations: Missing or unreviewed safety values remain NA; the legacy fixed 60 placeholder is rejected.
A final four-dimension ranking is emitted only when explicit reviewed safety and pair-evidence flags are complete for every pair.
The fixed-N compatibility file cuts through a score tie at the cutoff; use the with-cutoff-ties file for scientific reporting.
An emergent enriched term is statistical support, not proof of pharmacological synergy.
Experimental validation is required to establish 1+1>2.
